body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at King William Walk, East Greenwich.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ride on an Uber Boat by Thames Clippers to see London from the Thames. Visit Greenwich's Old Royal Naval College, a site with 600 years of history. This riverside estate is part of a UNESCO World Heritage site.
>
> See the Painted Hall, often called "UK’s Sistine Chapel," and learn about the birthplace of Henry VIII and Elizabeth I.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €39.75. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
